verdict.description: pass = sharp enough to write; borderline = marginal, allowed; fail = mediocre, must not reach the writer

sharpness.description: overall sharpness per the seven-point test

crack_real.description: crack names where the default reading concretely fails, not a restatement of it

counterexample_strong.description: the counterexample is one a thoughtful opponent would actually raise, not a straw man

boundary_clear.description: boundary states when the thesis holds and when it does not

frame_migrated.description: refined_thesis is a genuinely different frame from common_reading, not a paraphrase

weakest.description: the single weakest point, named; "none" only when verdict is pass and nothing is weak

hint.description: one concrete direction to sharpen: which frame to switch to, which mechanism to attach; when pass, an optional way to make it even sharper
